title: 第26章
content:
马寻一大清早的就听到了旺财在叫唤，立刻就穿衣起床。虽然穿衣比较繁琐，可是马寻还没有完全腐化，没让别人帮他穿衣。看到马寻，何大就抱怨说道，“国舅，旺财脾气也太大了，不顺心就要叫唤。”“是不是没给它拌点鸡蛋？”马寻好整以暇的说道，“它眼皮子浅，以后别在它眼皮子底下准备草料，准备好了直接倒进食槽。”何大记在了心里，说道，“以前陛下也有匹马，说是汗血马。我看着不像，那匹马也难伺候，让陈友谅给射死了。”徐蛾追了过来，担心说道，“老爷，早晨冷，得披上衣裳。”马寻从善如流，说道，“我先洗漱，一会就用饭，府里人都准备了吧？”徐蛾就说道，“老爷还没吃，我们哪能先吃。”“以后别管这些，到点了你们就吃。”马寻就说道，“我懒散，有些时候早上起不来，你们还干等着？”徐蛾想了想说道，“老爷，这不合规矩。”马寻直接说道，“规矩是死的，人是活的，人还能给尿憋死了？以后早饭定在辰时，午时二刻午饭，晚饭就定在酉时二刻。”七点早饭、十二点午饭，下午六点晚饭，这个时间安排的比较合适。一天三顿饭，在如今这个年代对普通百姓来说是非常有难度、奢侈，一些地主家也未必如此。但是在权贵家中，这么安排自然也没问题。用柳条蘸着青盐‘刷牙’结束，马寻就想着自己该弄出来牙刷了。其实牙刷这东西也有历史，秦代就有青铜牙刷，南宋时的牙刷和现代牙刷就非常接近了。马寻能做的可能也就是稍微改进一下牙刷，注意口腔卫生非常重要。徐蛾端上早餐，说道，“老爷，一会儿该进宫谢恩。”马寻非常意外的问道，“还要进宫谢恩？”“礼法上该去谢恩。”徐蛾耐心解释说道，“府邸是陛下赏赐的，皇后殿下和太子殿下昨日也来府里，老爷就该进宫谢恩。”马寻从善如流，只是有些担心，“我没奉诏啊，我现在也进不了宫。”徐蛾继续解释，“老爷可以请见，其他人能不能入宫难说，老爷要是请见，陛下肯定会召。”马寻也不在这些事情上和徐蛾等人犟，这些事情他确实不懂，所以就听取他们的一些建议。礼多人不怪，哪怕是亲戚人家，该注意礼数的时候也需要注意礼数。吃饱喝足的马寻牵着旺财就要出门，何大几人立刻就跟着。没有挎刀、提枪，只是有人拎着哨棒。京城的治安比较好，可是也担心有一些不长眼的人冲撞了贵人，该准备的还是要准备。坐在驴背上的马寻左看右看都不得劲，“我是不是该换匹马才好？驴太矮了，骑着不威风。”何大就笑着说道，“威风，国舅爷怎么都威风！”马寻不会骑马，这个事情何大等人也都知道，所以只能骑驴。“下回我倒着骑驴。”马寻小声自我吐槽，“到时候看着才威风点，我当初怎么就不攒点钱买匹马呢！”何大等人也都笑了起来，国舅爷当初买不起马，哪怕是驽马都买不起。而且以旺财现在的岁数来看，国舅爷还是买的小驴。一穷二白的，能买头驴就不错了，很多百姓家连个牲口都没有。

马寻的求见很顺利，基本上就等同于直接进宫，也不是去武英殿，而是被带着去柔仪殿了。那里是皇后办公的地方，马寻在朝堂上没有任何存在感，现在还只是一个国舅，是地地道道的外戚。马秀英看到马寻还是开心的，“怎么今天过来了？”“蛾子说我要入宫谢恩，我就来了。”马寻实话实说，“礼多人不怪，我不跟姐客气，也该谢谢姐夫。”马秀英笑着点头，“是这个道理，俺照顾你是天经地义。只是你姐夫没理由对你好，该谢的时候就得谢。”马寻酝酿了一下说道，“我得找点事情做啊，总不能一直闲着。”马秀英认真起来，“你想要做些什么事？你说不会打仗，也不知兵，要不然安排你进军中稍微历练一下？”马寻谨慎的问道，“我要是入军中，姐夫不会有意见吧？”马秀英明白马寻的意思，笑着反问，“担心外戚掌军，你姐夫不高兴？”马寻点头，历史的经验就是外戚掌权必遭清算，或者是外戚掌权后必生动乱。“你去了军中，能不能成大将都难说。”马秀英笑着开口，只是实话非常伤人，“有徐天德这些人在，你再有天分能比得过他们？”马寻的一些担心瞬间烟消云散，现在是开国初年，大明将帅云集、猛将如云，沐英、蓝玉、傅友德这些人现在都冒不了头。如今的大明军中实在是太奢华了，不是一些人不够优秀，而是有军功的人实在太多。历史上的朱元璋大封功臣，傅友德只是侯爵，位次二十八。而蓝玉更加干脆，第一次大封功臣的时候根本没有他的位置。不要说侯爵了，连个子爵都没有。沐英在第一次大封功臣的时候也没有爵位，这可是参与了平定福建、节制诸军的大将，如今在军中也只是后起之秀，算不上顶梁柱。看到马寻尴尬的样子，马秀英笑着说道，“让沐英带着你去军中，先熟悉一下。”马寻又问道，“这些事情还是要和姐夫说一声吧？”“又不是封你为将，俺能安排。”马秀英直接说道，“你在军中不要多管事，先多看多听多问，不要瞎折腾。”马寻连连点头，他有自知之明，他要是入军中，真就是菜鸟一个。该低调的时候就低调，哪怕因为身份的缘故会在军中如鱼得水。不过军中也是最讲究实力的地方，能力不够，即使是身份特殊，也会被人嘲笑。更何况要是不知好歹的想要逞能，损兵折将不说，还会让自己一命呜呼，那可就不好了。马寻又问道，“先前姐夫封我个帐前都尉的官职，在军中大概是个什么位置？”“将军之下。”马秀英笑着解释说道，“够用了，过段时间找些个机会让你出去转一圈，到时候授大都督府佥事。”马寻有些语气不确定了，“大都督府佥事？那不是得正二品，和尚书同阶？”“是正二品不假，你是国舅，迟早封为国公，那是超品。”马秀英耐心解释，“给你个官职，就是怕你只有爵位没有官职，俺和你姐夫早安排好了。”马寻一时间都不知道该怎么说了，他的未来看似都被安排的清清楚楚。不立功也没关系，超品的爵位、舒舒服服的过日子。只是这不是他的追求啊，他心里还是想要做点事情的。明初百废待兴，如果只是混吃等死，那实在有些说不过去。做些力所能及的事情，马寻这个国舅要奋斗了！

Ma Xun heard Wangcai's call early in the morning and immediately got dressed and got up.Although getting dressed was a bit cumbersome, Ma Xun was not completely corrupted yet and did not let others help him get dressed.Seeing Ma Xun, He Da complained, "Uncle, Wangcai has a very bad temper. He calls out when things don't go his way." "Didn't you mix some eggs with it?" Ma Xun said calmly, "It has short eyelids. Don't prepare fodder under its nose in the future. When it's ready, pour it directly into the trough."He took it to heart and said, "His Majesty also had a horse before, which was said to be a sweaty horse. I didn't look like it, and that horse was difficult to take care of, so Chen Youliang shot it to death." Xu Mo chased after him and said worriedly, "Master, it's cold in the morning, so you have to put on clothes." Ma Xun followed the good example and said, "I'll wash up first.We'll have dinner soon, are the people in the house ready?" Xu Mo said, "Master hasn't eaten yet, how can we eat first?" "Don't worry about this in the future, you can eat when it's time." Ma Xun said, "I'm lazy and can't get up in the morning, why are you waiting?" Xu Mo thought for a while and said."Master, this is against the rules."Ma Xun said directly, "Rules are dead, people are alive, how can people choke themselves to death? From now on, breakfast will be at 2:00 p.m., lunch will be at 2:00 p.m., and dinner will be at 2:00 p.m."This time arrangement is more appropriate.Three meals a day is very difficult and luxurious for ordinary people in this era, and this may not be the case for some landlords.But in a wealthy family, such an arrangement is naturally no problem.After finishing brushing his teeth with a wicker dipped in green salt, Ma Xun thought it was time to get a toothbrush.In fact, toothbrushes also have history. There were bronze toothbrushes in the Qin Dynasty. The toothbrushes in the Southern Song Dynasty are very close to modern toothbrushes.What Ma Xun can probably do is to slightly improve his toothbrush. Paying attention to oral hygiene is very important.Xu Mo served breakfast and said, "Master, I will go to the palace to thank you soon." Ma Xun asked very unexpectedly, "Do you want to go to the palace to thank me?" "Etiquette dictates that you should go to the palace to thank me." Xu Mo explained patiently, "The mansion was given by His Majesty. Her Royal Highness the Queen and His Royal Highness the Crown Prince also came to the palace yesterday, so I should enter the palace to thank you." Ma Xun followed suit,He was just a little worried, "I didn't receive the imperial edict, and I can't enter the palace now." Xu Mo continued to explain, "The master can invite you, but it's hard to say whether others can enter the palace. If the master invites you, your majesty will definitely summon him." Ma Xun didn't argue with Xu Mo and others on these matters. He really didn't understand these things, so he listened to some of their suggestions.It’s not strange to be polite to many people. Even if you are a relative, you still need to pay attention to etiquette when it’s time to pay attention to etiquette.After eating and drinking, Ma Xun took Wangcai and was about to go out. He Da and others immediately followed.There were no knives or guns, just someone carrying a whistle stick.The security in the capital is relatively good, but we are still worried that some unsighted people may bump into the nobles, so we still have to be prepared.Ma Xun, who was sitting on the donkey's back, couldn't look left or right, "Should I change a horse? The donkey is too short, and it doesn't look impressive when riding on it." He Da smiled and said, "Awesome, uncle Guo is so impressive!" Ma Xun couldn't ride a horse, and He Da and others knew this, so he could only ride on a donkey."Next time I'll ride the donkey backwards." Ma Xun complained to himself in a low voice, "It will look more impressive then. Why didn't I save some money to buy a horse?" He Da and others also laughed. Uncle Guo couldn't afford to buy a horse, not even a horse.And judging from Wangcai's current age, Uncle Guo still bought a little donkey.As a poor person, it would be great if you can buy a donkey. Many people don't even have any livestock.

Ma Xun's request for an audience went smoothly. It was basically equivalent to entering the palace directly. Instead of going to Wuying Hall, he was taken to Rouyi Hall.That was where the queen worked. Ma Xun had no sense of presence in the court. He was still just an uncle, a real relative.Ma Xiuying was still happy to see Ma Xun, "Why did you come here today?" "The moth said I wanted to go to the palace to thank you, so I came." Ma Xun told the truth, "It's not surprising that there are many people giving gifts. I should not be polite to my sister, so I should thank my brother-in-law." Ma Xiuying saidYing smiled and nodded, "That's the truth. It's only natural for me to take care of you. It's just that your brother-in-law has no reason to be nice to you. You have to thank him when you deserve it." Ma Xun thought for a while and said, "I have to find something to do. I can't be idle all the time.Wait." Ma Xiuying became serious, "What do you want to do?You said you don't know how to fight and don't know how to be a soldier.How about I arrange for you to have some experience in the army?" Ma Xun asked cautiously, "If I join the army, my brother-in-law will not be able to do it.Do you have any opinion?" Ma Xiuying understood what Ma Xun meant and asked with a smile, "Are you worried that your brother-in-law will be unhappy if your foreign relatives take charge of the army?" Ma Xun nodded. Historical experience is that when a foreign relative takes power, there will be liquidation, or there will be chaos after a foreign relative takes power."It's hard to say whether you can become a general if you go to the army." Ma Xiuying said with a smile, but the truth was very hurtful, "With people like Xu Tiande here, no matter how talented you are, how can you compare to them?" Some of Ma Xun's worries disappeared in an instant. It was the early years of the founding of the People's Republic of China, and the Ming Dynasty was full of generals and fierce generals. People like Mu Ying, Lan Yu, and Fu Youde couldn't stand up now.Today's Ming Dynasty's army is too luxurious. It's not that some people are not good enough, but that there are too many people with military merit.In history, Zhu Yuanzhang was a great official, while Fu Youde was only a marquis, ranking twenty-eighth.But Lan Yu was more straightforward. When he was awarded the title of hero for the first time, there was no place for him at all.Not to mention marquis, not even viscount.Mu Ying did not have a title when he was first awarded a title of meritorious official. This was a general who participated in pacifying Fujian and controlling the armies. Now he is just a rising star in the army and cannot be regarded as a pillar.Seeing Ma Xun's embarrassed look, Ma Xiuying said with a smile, "Let Mu Ying take you to the army to get familiar with it first." Ma Xun asked again, "Should I talk to my brother-in-law about these things?" "It's not like I will make you a general. I can arrange it." Ma Xiuying said directly, "Don't meddle in the army. You should watch, listen and ask more first, and don't mess around." Ma Xun nodded repeatedly. He knew that if he joined the army, he would really be a rookie.Keep a low profile when you should, even if you are in the military because of your status.However, the military is also a place where strength is the most important. If you are not capable enough, even if you have a special status, you will be laughed at.What's more, if you want to show off your talents without knowing what's good, and not only lose your troops, but also let yourself die, that's not good.Ma Xun asked again, "What was the official position of the captain before my brother-in-law granted me the title of captain in the army?" "Below the general." Ma Xiuying explained with a smile, "That's enough. I'll find some opportunities for you to go out for a while, and then you will be awarded the governor's office." Ma Xun sounded a little uncertain, "The governor's office? That's not it."It's true that you have a second rank. You are the uncle of the country, and you will be named a prince sooner or later. That's a super rank."Ma Xiuying explained patiently, "I'm afraid that you will only have a title but no official position. Your brother-in-law and I didn't know what to say for a while. His future seemed to be clearly arranged.It doesn't matter if you don't make meritorious deeds, you can get a superior title and live a comfortable life.But this is not his pursuit, he still wants to do something in his heart.In the early Ming Dynasty, there was a lot of waste waiting for things to be done. If we just ate and waited to die, it would be unreasonable.Do what you can, Ma Xun, the uncle of the country, is going to fight!

马寻一大清早的就听到了旺财在叫唤，立刻就穿衣起床。虽然穿衣比较繁琐，可是马寻还没有完全腐化，没让别人帮他穿衣。看到马寻，何大就抱怨说道，“国舅，旺财脾气也太大了，不顺心就要叫唤。”“是不是没给它拌点鸡蛋？”马寻好整以暇的说道，“它眼皮子浅，以后别在它眼皮子底下准备草料，准备好了直接倒进食槽。”何大记在了心里，说道，“以前陛下也有匹马，说是汗血马。我看着不像，那匹马也难伺候，让陈友谅给射死了。”徐蛾追了过来，担心说道，“老爷，早晨冷，得披上衣裳。”马寻从善如流，说道，“我先洗漱，一会就用饭，府里人都准备了吧？”徐蛾就说道，“老爷还没吃，我们哪能先吃。”“以后别管这些，到点了你们就吃。”马寻就说道，“我懒散，有些时候早上起不来，你们还干等着？”徐蛾想了想说道，“老爷，这不合规矩。”马寻直接说道，“规矩是死的，人是活的，人还能给尿憋死了？以后早饭定在辰时，午时二刻午饭，晚饭就定在酉时二刻。”七点早饭、十二点午饭，下午六点晚饭，这个时间安排的比较合适。一天三顿饭，在如今这个年代对普通百姓来说是非常有难度、奢侈，一些地主家也未必如此。但是在权贵家中，这么安排自然也没问题。用柳条蘸着青盐‘刷牙’结束，马寻就想着自己该弄出来牙刷了。其实牙刷这东西也有历史，秦代就有青铜牙刷，南宋时的牙刷和现代牙刷就非常接近了。马寻能做的可能也就是稍微改进一下牙刷，注意口腔卫生非常重要。徐蛾端上早餐，说道，“老爷，一会儿该进宫谢恩。”马寻非常意外的问道，“还要进宫谢恩？”“礼法上该去谢恩。”徐蛾耐心解释说道，“府邸是陛下赏赐的，皇后殿下和太子殿下昨日也来府里，老爷就该进宫谢恩。”马寻从善如流，只是有些担心，“我没奉诏啊，我现在也进不了宫。”徐蛾继续解释，“老爷可以请见，其他人能不能入宫难说，老爷要是请见，陛下肯定会召。”马寻也不在这些事情上和徐蛾等人犟，这些事情他确实不懂，所以就听取他们的一些建议。礼多人不怪，哪怕是亲戚人家，该注意礼数的时候也需要注意礼数。吃饱喝足的马寻牵着旺财就要出门，何大几人立刻就跟着。没有挎刀、提枪，只是有人拎着哨棒。京城的治安比较好，可是也担心有一些不长眼的人冲撞了贵人，该准备的还是要准备。坐在驴背上的马寻左看右看都不得劲，“我是不是该换匹马才好？驴太矮了，骑着不威风。”何大就笑着说道，“威风，国舅爷怎么都威风！”马寻不会骑马，这个事情何大等人也都知道，所以只能骑驴。“下回我倒着骑驴。”马寻小声自我吐槽，“到时候看着才威风点，我当初怎么就不攒点钱买匹马呢！”何大等人也都笑了起来，国舅爷当初买不起马，哪怕是驽马都买不起。而且以旺财现在的岁数来看，国舅爷还是买的小驴。一穷二白的，能买头驴就不错了，很多百姓家连个牲口都没有。

马寻的求见很顺利，基本上就等同于直接进宫，也不是去武英殿，而是被带着去柔仪殿了。那里是皇后办公的地方，马寻在朝堂上没有任何存在感，现在还只是一个国舅，是地地道道的外戚。马秀英看到马寻还是开心的，“怎么今天过来了？”“蛾子说我要入宫谢恩，我就来了。”马寻实话实说，“礼多人不怪，我不跟姐客气，也该谢谢姐夫。”马秀英笑着点头，“是这个道理，俺照顾你是天经地义。只是你姐夫没理由对你好，该谢的时候就得谢。”马寻酝酿了一下说道，“我得找点事情做啊，总不能一直闲着。”马秀英认真起来，“你想要做些什么事？你说不会打仗，也不知兵，要不然安排你进军中稍微历练一下？”马寻谨慎的问道，“我要是入军中，姐夫不会有意见吧？”马秀英明白马寻的意思，笑着反问，“担心外戚掌军，你姐夫不高兴？”马寻点头，历史的经验就是外戚掌权必遭清算，或者是外戚掌权后必生动乱。“你去了军中，能不能成大将都难说。”马秀英笑着开口，只是实话非常伤人，“有徐天德这些人在，你再有天分能比得过他们？”马寻的一些担心瞬间烟消云散，现在是开国初年，大明将帅云集、猛将如云，沐英、蓝玉、傅友德这些人现在都冒不了头。如今的大明军中实在是太奢华了，不是一些人不够优秀，而是有军功的人实在太多。历史上的朱元璋大封功臣，傅友德只是侯爵，位次二十八。而蓝玉更加干脆，第一次大封功臣的时候根本没有他的位置。不要说侯爵了，连个子爵都没有。沐英在第一次大封功臣的时候也没有爵位，这可是参与了平定福建、节制诸军的大将，如今在军中也只是后起之秀，算不上顶梁柱。看到马寻尴尬的样子，马秀英笑着说道，“让沐英带着你去军中，先熟悉一下。”马寻又问道，“这些事情还是要和姐夫说一声吧？”“又不是封你为将，俺能安排。”马秀英直接说道，“你在军中不要多管事，先多看多听多问，不要瞎折腾。”马寻连连点头，他有自知之明，他要是入军中，真就是菜鸟一个。该低调的时候就低调，哪怕因为身份的缘故会在军中如鱼得水。不过军中也是最讲究实力的地方，能力不够，即使是身份特殊，也会被人嘲笑。更何况要是不知好歹的想要逞能，损兵折将不说，还会让自己一命呜呼，那可就不好了。马寻又问道，“先前姐夫封我个帐前都尉的官职，在军中大概是个什么位置？”“将军之下。”马秀英笑着解释说道，“够用了，过段时间找些个机会让你出去转一圈，到时候授大都督府佥事。”马寻有些语气不确定了，“大都督府佥事？那不是得正二品，和尚书同阶？”“是正二品不假，你是国舅，迟早封为国公，那是超品。”马秀英耐心解释，“给你个官职，就是怕你只有爵位没有官职，俺和你姐夫早安排好了。”马寻一时间都不知道该怎么说了，他的未来看似都被安排的清清楚楚。不立功也没关系，超品的爵位、舒舒服服的过日子。只是这不是他的追求啊，他心里还是想要做点事情的。明初百废待兴，如果只是混吃等死，那实在有些说不过去。做些力所能及的事情，马寻这个国舅要奋斗了！
